description: XML-RPC replies from Frontier::RPC2 0.07b4 under Frontier::Daemon, serving the gateway's five methods over data.json.
substitutions: The gateway's XML-RPC endpoint is documented as Frontier::RPC behind Apache 1.3 since 1999. This is the module's last release, 0.07b4 (2002), as Debian 12 packages it, served by its own Frontier::Daemon instead of Apache, so the HTTP head is HTTP::Daemon's.
The handlers are this set's frontier.pl, written for the recording; the encoder, the dispatcher and the HTTP server are the module's.
client: scripts/record.mjs: a raw TCP socket from the host to the published port; each request is written as listed, with Content-Length and Connection: close added.
commands: docker exec hostile-recording-frontier-rpc2 perl -e print qq{$^V\n}
docker exec hostile-recording-frontier-rpc2 dpkg-query --show libfrontier-rpc-perl libhttp-daemon-perl libxml-parser-perl perl

exchanges.name: account-title
exchanges.description: account.title("00012345"): a title with letters outside ASCII, returned as a plain scalar.

exchanges.name: invoice-get
exchanges.description: invoice.get(7): a struct of an integer, an all-digit string, a double, a boolean, two dates and an array of structs whose text needs escaping.

exchanges.name: invoice-unpaid
exchanges.description: invoice.get(8): false, the zero date, a migrated impossible date and an empty array.

exchanges.name: extract-fetch
exchanges.description: extract.fetch("202610"): 320 bytes of ISO-8859-1 as base64, encoded by MIME::Base64's encode_base64 with its default line ends.

exchanges.name: fault-not-found
exchanges.description: invoice.get(999): the handler dies, which is the only error a Frontier::Daemon handler can report.

exchanges.name: fault-malformed
exchanges.description: A call that is not well-formed XML: a bare ampersand.

exchanges.name: not-xml
exchanges.description: A well-formed call sent as text/plain.
